name: Lahaina, HI
story: Lahaina, Maui. Afternoon of August 8, 2023. A downed power line above Lahainaluna Road re-ignited in 60 mph downslope winds.
homes_note: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at pre-fire density (Lahaina CDP, ~12,700 people / ~3 per household), not individual footprints.
